name: Cycle support supplements

card.summary: Cycle support supplements are over-the-counter products, often for liver, heart and lipid health, that people who use anabolic compounds take alongside them to protect the health that sustains training and physique.
card.note: Supplements do not make anabolic steroid use safe; health monitoring by a clinician is the usual medical guidance.

quick.overview:
Cycle support is community shorthand for a set of supplements, commonly aimed at the liver, cardiovascular health and blood lipids, taken by people running 'cycles' of anabolic compounds.

The appearance chain is indirect: proponents say staying healthy lets them keep training and holding muscle gained.
quick.how: Users describe stacking OTC products such as bile-acid supplements (TUDCA), antioxidants or fish oil with their regimen, along with blood tests. This article gives no dosing.
quick.risks: Clinicians note that these products have not been shown to offset the effects of anabolic steroids, and blood work and medical supervision are the standard safety measures discussed.

lead: Cycle support supplements are the products people add around a cycle of anabolic compounds, typically targeting the liver, heart and lipids. The term is used in forum culture rather than clinical literature.

One example is tauroursodeoxycholic acid (TUDCA), a bile acid related to ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA). UDCA was first identified in bear bile and is now made semisynthetically; it is approved for primary biliary cholangitis and used to dissolve gallstones. [1]
Proponents see the supplements as maintaining health so that training and gains continue; the clinical literature on UDCA concerns liver and gallbladder disease, not steroid use. [1]

chain: Support liver, heart and lipid markers
angle.text: Users take these supplements in the belief that they preserve the health needed to keep training and so protect physique gains.

paras: The set varies by user, but liver, cardiovascular and lipid support products are the common categories. Medical literature on related compounds such as UDCA describes uses in gallstones, primary biliary cholangitis and cholestasis of pregnancy, with reported side effects including diarrhoea and abdominal pain. [1]
No studies found examining cycle support supplement sets in people using anabolic compounds. Studies of UDCA in liver disease exist but concern those conditions. [1]
